name: Primal Abatement
description: Abate hostile soul force back to the silence from which all sound arose.

name: Origin Gauge
description: Gauge the origin of a hostile soul force and learn exactly what will return it to silence.

name: Root Calm
description: Root the soul in the deepest calm so that no hostile surge can shift or crack it.

name: Primal Absolution
description: Absolve an ally of every curse and taint laid on the soul by returning it to the quiet before them.

name: World Hush
description: Lay a hush over the whole field so that hostile soul techniques of every kind are cancelled.

name: Unseen Rebuke
description: Return a barrage of hostile soul strikes upon their casters without a sound or a sign.

name: Binding Quiet
description: Bind the soul force of a foe host in a quiet it cannot break until the master lets it go.

name: Healing Stillness
description: Let a deep stillness heal the souls of every wounded ally by cancelling their hurts.

name: Origin Silence
description: Call the silence of the origin over a company with a hold set by the Core of the master.

name: Stillness Absolute
description: Hold an absolute stillness about the master whose reach and weight follow the formed Core.

name: Silencing Ruin
description: Silence the soul force of a vast host to the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier nullifier.

name: Undone Hour
description: Cancel a hostile technique so wholly that it was never cast; no cultivation mechanic explains how an act is unmade.
